captions: Final exam. Room 4. Three questions still blank.
The clock on the wall moves faster than your pen.
You'd give anything for five more minutes.
“Pens down.” Half your page is still empty.
One day, no one will say “five minutes left.”
Home. 4 p.m. Asr is already in.
This time, you don't wait for the last minute.
Cold water on your hands. You still have time. Today.

post.caption:
8 minutes left on the exam. How many left in your life? 🤍

In an exam, we beg for five more minutes. In life, we still have them, today.

“Every soul will taste death.” (3:185)

Pray Asr now, before the sun sets.
